name: taskflow-mobile
description: Android app for Trilo Task Flow (Capacitor wrapper around the website build in ../dist)

scripts.build:web: cd .. && npm run build && rm -rf mobile/www && mkdir -p mobile/www && cp -R dist/. mobile/www/ && rm -rf mobile/www/download
scripts.setup: npm run build:web && cap add android && npm run icons && cap sync android
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build:web && cap sync ios
